name: NucleiLens v0.2.0 — inspectable model QA
body:
## Research prototype

Compare actual Cellpose/StarDist predictions and aligned external label TIFFs; inspect correspondence hypotheses, explicitly confirm safe component replacements, undo exactly, and recalculate/export pixel measurements with source/mask hashes.

One real CC0 training field yielded 68 instances from each neural model with different partitions. This is integration/demo evidence, not a comparative accuracy result. Both models reran after optional dependency remediation with pixel-identical outputs.

Public V6 includes the complete verified scientific runtime and passes actual browser inference, edit/undo/TIFF/hash, model QA, CSV/report and accessibility/mobile-layout checks. V6 was built from GitHub commit 23d592638ff1d20f483aa9753ab447d335e5efda; this release additionally records public delivery evidence and refines test-only hosting-traffic reporting. Application and frozen scientific source remain unchanged from V6. The frozen numerical engine's reported version remains 0.1.0.

45 native and 22 frontend tests pass; exact-head CI and merge/source evidence are in evaluation/checks/. The graph/NNLS negative results and all 50/496-field assessments are preserved unchanged.

Live: https://nuclei-lens.dumbthing999.chatgpt.site
Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/nucleilens

### Limits
Cellpose/StarDist/napari/CellSampler are prior art. Human benefit, independent-source generalization, clinical validity and winning scores are not established. Known Cloudflare challenge traffic is disclosed. This is a prerelease, not final submission. The reviewed 3:35 video upload was rejected by YouTube daily quota; a guarded retry is scheduled, with no verified playback yet.
